svg.aria-label: AI usage intelligence: Usage and cost tracking for a ten-person Claude team. One SQLite database feeds three ways in: a web dashboard, a terminal tool and a Claude Code command. A Refresh button on the shared page wakes an agent that downloads fresh exports and republishes.
